headline: Second empty day; scores hold almost still
body: Another quiet weekend day with no scored events. The slow fade of older news continued, moving each line by a hundredth of a point at most. Nothing changes the picture left by the week's agent launches and chip results. Horizon Balance: +0.78.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); changes were single hundredths from fading contributions.
